title: mentha aquatica var. agardhiana
intro: Mentha aquatica var. agardhiana, commonly known as American water mint, is a variant of the water mint plant native to North America. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant agent, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of American water mint include its use as a carminative, expectorant, and antispasmodic, making it effective in relieving nausea, coughs, and muscle spasms. Bioactive constituents of this plant include menthone, menthyl acetate, and limonene, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
